label: Read stored tool result
description: Read a bounded character slice of a large tool result that was stored after truncation. Use only a result_ref returned by a prior tool, and request the smallest slice needed. Advance offset to continue; do not restart at zero repeatedly. The content retains the trust level of the original tool result.

parameter_descriptions.result_ref: The exact stored result reference returned by a prior tool.
parameter_descriptions.offset: Zero-based character offset into the stored result.
parameter_descriptions.limit: Maximum characters to return, from 256 to 16000.
